title: A scientific result is verified only on evidence that supports it, at the store
note: The admission policy for kind scientific_result, in agent_substrate/result_rules.py, enforced by AuthorityStore.transition on the edges into VERIFIED and PROMOTED. RR1, RR2, RR3, RR5 and RR6 are ST11, ST10, ST17, ST13 and ST14 of scientific_thermal_1d, moved here with the rule they test. RR8-RR11 re-anchored when the content rule became policy scientific_result.admission/1; RR11 now breaks the store's refusal of an undecidable claim, since the old anchor became an equivalent mutant (an absent fetch is itself unreadable evidence). Origin, replay and the second reader are scientific_authority_replay.json. Stage 5: RR18 and RR19 put back AUD-027 -- a cited document holding a number JSON does not have raised out of the rule instead of being a problem.

mutations.name: RR19_a_bundle_with_no_canonical_form_raises
mutations.find:
try:
        bundle_digest = digest(bundle)
    except ValueError:
        # a numeral past the float range reads as infinity, which no
        # canonical form holds: a problem, not an exception (AUD-027)
        bundle_digest = None
        problems.append("the cited bundle has no canonical form")
mutations.rationale: AUD-027: a numeral past the float range makes the rule raise CanonicalizationError, which neither the live edge nor replay expects
